Row.Text: 组队PVP横向大陆
横向一字排开的2至12人组队战场；主大陆名义长度约为17×人数格、生成时再缩短约10%，厚18格。东西岸拥有2格浅海大陆架、岛屿与海洋资源；南北岸不生成岛屿，仅保留贴岸浅海，其余均为深海。默认东西分队并严格平分两队区域；雨林不受纬度限制而随机成片分布。
默认东西分队；两队按地图几何中线分居面积相等的东西两半，即使队伍人数不同也不移动分界。
横向队内前后排（软偏好）
启用后，同队大厅排位越靠上越倾向本队外侧后方，越靠下越倾向中线前方。仍优先保证一字横排、队伍半区和文明间距；海岸文明不受影响，优先本队东西外海岸。默认关闭。
Team PVP Horizontal Mainland

A 2-12 player team battlefield arranged in one long east-west line. Its mainland starts from a nominal 17 tiles per player, is shortened by about 10% during generation, and is 18 tiles deep. The east and west shores have two-tile shelves, islands and sea resources; the north and south seas have no islands, retain only shore-adjacent shallows and otherwise stay deep. Teams default to equal east/west halves; jungle forms random clusters without a tropical-latitude restriction.
Defaults to east-west teams. The geometric midpoint always gives the two teams equal east/west areas, even when their player counts differ.
Horizontal Team Front/Back Order (Soft)

When enabled, earlier lobby rows prefer their team's outer rear and later rows prefer the center-facing front. The single horizontal line, team half and civilization spacing remain higher priorities. Coastal civilizations ignore this preference and prioritize their team's outer east/west shore. Disabled by default.
